5M9vn4XLBoQ@0.detail: Go into the crop fields west of Southshore by the barn and the wooden frame structure. Run along the rows and hit each Hillsbrad Peasant and Farmer with a quick ranged spell such as Fireball, Frostbolt or Fire Blast as you pass, so they all chase you. Keep moving until you have the whole group behind you, then turn, Frost Nova them in place and step back to range. Channel Blizzard on the pack; with Improved Blizzard they stay slowed as you back off. When they break out, Frost Nova again or Blink away and do another Blizzard. Once they are low, finish with Flamestrike plus Arcane Explosion, or let them flee at low health and burn them down. 5n9od9fcoz0@315.detail: Use this right after you loot the Azure Agate from the Boulderfist Shamans. 1) Mount up in the courtyard. 2) Ride south toward the tall tan outer wall, where long, waist-high, dark iron railings with rivets on top sit in front of a wooden plank fence. 3) Jump onto the railing near where it meets the wall; the top is flat and wide enough to ride on. 4) Follow the railing along the wall and around its corner, past the bare dead tree. Ogres and Witherbark Berserkers in the yard below may aggro, but they can't reach you up there, and you drop combat on your own. 5) At the far end the outer wall has a broken gap. Ride through it and drop down onto the grass outside. 6) Head southeast to Faldir's Cove along the path between the mountains and Stromgarde's southeastern wall. This saves fighting your way back out through the elite ogres and trolls. Don't stop to fight on the way. If you fall off into the yard, get back on the railing or leave the normal way.

Open with Immolate and Corruption, put the pet on him, then walk west along the shore past the fenced crop plots into Lakeshire. If you run too far ahead, he loses you and stays on the pet. Once you damage him again, he comes back for you. In town he reached melee and hit for about 105 a swing. Second attempt, from the lake by the road: the pet tanks while you shoot, trap him when he turns on you, and kite east over the hills and through the Boulder'gor rocks toward Refuge Pointe. Pull: Frostbolt a turtle swimming near the bank, then a second and a third, so 2-3 come ashore together onto the grass. Fight on land, not in the water. Kill: Frost Nova as they arrive, then spam Arcane Explosion (about 100 per hit). Frost spells show lots of Resists here, so Arcane does the killing. Between casts, jump backwards with a strafe key held so the turtles keep chasing and swing less often. That's how you avoid most melee damage. Keep Mana Shield up the whole fight: even so, health hit Health Low on one 3-turtle pull. Arcane Explosion drains mana fast, so drink before each group.
